findings.state: Area at rest, any workspace: the 8th quality check and the tier label
findings.current: activeAccounts: totalWorked.value  →  check renders "The working account list is small; confirm that the list is large enough to support the planned outreach volume." (SMB walkthrough, area at rest) while the same screen says "HOW YOUR 29 WATCHED ACCOUNTS MATCH THE ICP"
findings.problem: totalWorked is not an account count. It is the number of ICPs marked worked (demo seed: icps.filter(i=>i.worked).length, js/demo-seed-runtime.js:191) and it is bumped by 1 every time an ICP is saved (state.ts saveDraftAsIcp → bumpTotalWorked(1)). The quality engine treats it as the working-list size, so the screen tells the user their account list is small (or 'No working-list size is recorded yet') based on a count of saved ICPs. The comment at line 68-69 repeats the wrong premise. This also lowers/raises the quality score and the tier the user sees. Second divergence: saveDraftAsIcp() computes the stored qualityScore with engineActive (always 0 from v4, which has no input for it), so the score saved and later read by Signal Console/Readiness (bestSavedIcp, readiness quality) differs from the score shown when the user clicked Save.
findings.governing: COPY_STANDARD.md §21 (claims discipline: never more certain than the data); comprehension principle; AUDIT_BRIEF §5 'copy that now claims something the code does not do'
findings.proposed: Pass the number of watched accounts the screen already reads: in IcpStudioV4 compute `const accounts = readAccounts();` before buildIcpQuality and use `activeAccounts: accounts.length`; correct the comment at lines 68-69. In state.ts saveDraftAsIcp accept an optional activeAccounts override (default engineActive) and pass the same accounts.length from the v4 save() so the stored qualityScore equals the score shown. OWNER DECISION: whether the working-list check should measure watched Signal Console accounts or a separate target the user enters (the ds/legacy screens have an engineActive input; v4 has none).
testsAffected: src/icp-studio/state.test.ts (saveDraftAsIcp quality assertions, if the signature changes)

findings.state: Area at rest with watched accounts: account-match columns
findings.current: Header "Accounts that do not match · and why"; rows render only "Notion — Productivity Software" / "Warby Parker — DTC Eyewear"; partial matches are counted ("3 partial matches") but never listed or explained
findings.problem: Batch 01 structural requirement for ICP Studio says the account-match area must answer how many strongly match, partially match, do not match, AND why. The header promises a reason but each row shows only the account's industry, so the user must infer the comparison (industry vs ICP industry, HQ vs ICP geography) themselves. The 3 partial matches have no list and no reason at all. The match is computed only from industry and geography (scoreAccountAgainstIcp) — company size is ignored — which the screen never says.
findings.governing: ANTAEUS_FINAL_AUDIT_CONTROL_PACKET_2026-11-16/antaeus-audit-control/original-working-set/04_REWRITE_BATCH_01_SHARED_AND_CORE.md 'Structural requirements · ICP Studio' (account-match area must answer why)
findings.proposed: Derive a reason per account from the same two comparisons scoreAccountAgainstIcp makes and render it: non-match row "Notion — industry is Productivity Software, not Food service / DTC / CPG"; when industry matches but HQ does not: "<name> — based outside US". Add a third column "Partial matches · and why" listing up to 2 with the same reason format plus "+ N more partial matches". Under the counts add one line: "Matching compares each account's industry and headquarters with the ICP. Company size is not used."

findings.state: Area at rest, footer next to 'Save this ICP'
findings.current: This ICP is used to score accounts in Territory · Prospecting · Signal Console · Outbound · Discovery and contributes to Readiness and sales handoff documentation.
findings.problem: The claim is not what the code does. A repo-wide search for readers of gtmos_icp_analytics / bestSavedIcp / matchAccountToIcp finds no reader in territory-architect, outbound-studio or discovery-studio. ICP match scores are computed only in Signal Console's ds/legacy account cards (signal-console/components/AccountCard.tsx, ds/components/AccountCardDS.tsx) — the default Signal Console v4 screen does not show them — and on this ICP Studio screen. Prospecting Desk reads the ICP as search context (prospecting-desk/lib/research-context.ts), LinkedIn Playbook reads it for context, and Readiness (dashboard/lib/readiness-aggregator.ts) and Founding GTM (founding-gtm/lib/cross-room.ts) do read it. A first-time user is told five areas score their accounts with this ICP; three never read it.
findings.governing: COPY_STANDARD.md §21 (claims discipline); original record INV-0255 (01_USER_FACING_COPY_INVENTORY.json records[255], 'review_and_rewrite_if_functional_meaning_is_obscured'); AUDIT_BRIEF §5 copy that claims something the code does not do
findings.proposed: Replace with what is wired today: "This ICP is shown as a match score on this page, guides account searches in Prospecting Desk, and counts toward Readiness and the sales handoff documentation." OWNER DECISION: if Territory, Outbound and Discovery are meant to use the ICP, that is new behavior to build; until then the screen must not say they do.
